Class GuiCraftingPlanToggler

java.lang.Object
org.cyclops.integratedterminals.client.gui.container.component.GuiCraftingPlanToggler
public class GuiCraftingPlanToggler extends Object
A helper class that allows toggling between a tree-based, graph-based and flattened crafting plan view.

    • resolveDisplayMode

      public void resolveDisplayMode()
      Determine the active display mode, without initializing it. This can be called before the gui size is determined.

    • getDefaultDisplayMode

      public static GuiCraftingPlanToggler.CraftingPlanDisplayMode getDefaultDisplayMode(boolean hasTree, boolean hasFlat, @Nullable GuiCraftingPlanToggler.CraftingPlanDisplayMode preferred, boolean defaultToTree, boolean treeListEnabled)
      Parameters:
      hasTree - If a tree-based plan is available.
      hasFlat - If a flattened plan is available.
      preferred - The mode the player last chose, or null.
      defaultToTree - If a tree-based view should be preferred over the flattened view.
      treeListEnabled - If the tree list view can be shown.
      Returns:
      The display mode to show when a plan is opened.
